{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module Main where

import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay, MVar, newMVar, readMVar, modifyMVar_, modifyMVar)
import Control.Concurrent.Async (async, wait, concurrently)
import Control.Monad (when, unless, void)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime, diffUTCTime)
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Pool state representing a DeFi-like lending pool
data PoolState = PoolState
  { poolBalance    :: !Integer
  , poolReserve    :: !Integer
  , poolLastUpdate :: !UTCTime
  , poolLoanActive :: !Bool
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

data LoanRequest = LoanRequest
  { loanAmount   :: !Integer
  , loanBorrower :: !String
  , loanCallback :: IO Integer  -- callback returns repayment amount
  }

data TxResult = TxSuccess | TxFailed String deriving (Show)

-- Global pool state
{-# NOINLINE globalPool #-}
globalPool :: MVar PoolState
globalPool = unsafePerformIO $ do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  newMVar (PoolState 1000000 500000 now False)

-- Fee calculation: 0.3% fee on flash loans
calculateFee :: Integer -> Integer
calculateFee amount = max 1 (amount * 3 `div` 1000)

-- Snapshot for balance verification
data BalanceSnapshot = BalanceSnapshot
  { snapBalance :: !Integer
  , snapReserve :: !Integer
  , snapTime    :: !UTCTime
  } deriving (Show)

takeSnapshot :: PoolState -> IO BalanceSnapshot
takeSnapshot ps = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  return $ BalanceSnapshot (poolBalance ps) (poolReserve ps) now

-- Core flash loan execution with async callback
executeFlashLoan :: LoanRequest -> IO TxResult
executeFlashLoan req = do
  let amount = loanAmount req
  when (amount <= 0) $ error "Invalid loan amount"
  
  -- Phase 1: Take snapshot and disburse funds
  snapshot <- modifyMVar globalPool $ \ps -> do
    when (poolLoanActive ps) $ error "Reentrancy detected"
    when (amount > poolBalance ps) $ error "Insufficient liquidity"
    snap <- takeSnapshot ps
    let ps' = ps { poolBalance = poolBalance ps - amount
                 , poolLoanActive = True
                 }
    return (ps', snap)
  
  -- Phase 2: Execute borrower's callback asynchronously
  repaymentAsync <- async (loanCallback req)
  repayment <- wait repaymentAsync
  
  -- Phase 3: Verify repayment and update state
  result <- modifyMVar globalPool $ \ps -> do
    let expectedRepayment = amount + calculateFee amount
    -- Verify against snapshot balance for invariant check
    let currentTotal = poolBalance ps + repayment
    let requiredTotal = snapBalance snapshot
    if currentTotal >= requiredTotal
      then do
        let ps' = ps { poolBalance = poolBalance ps + repayment
                     , poolLoanActive = False
                     }
        return (ps', TxSuccess)
      else do
        -- Rollback: restore original balance
        let ps' = ps { poolBalance = snapBalance snapshot
                     , poolLoanActive = False
                     }
        return (ps', TxFailed "Insufficient repayment")
  
  return result

-- Price oracle simulation (used in arbitrage)
data PriceOracle = PriceOracle
  { oraclePrice    :: IORef Integer
  , oracleUpdated  :: IORef UTCTime
  }

newOracle :: Integer -> IO PriceOracle
newOracle price = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  p <- newIORef price
  t <- newIORef now
  return $ PriceOracle p t

getPrice :: PriceOracle -> IO Integer
getPrice oracle = readIORef (oraclePrice oracle)

-- Collateral manager for nested operations
data CollateralManager = CollateralManager
  { collateralMap :: MVar (Map String Integer)
  }

newCollateralManager :: IO CollateralManager
newCollateralManager = do
  m <- newMVar Map.empty
  return $ CollateralManager m

depositCollateral :: CollateralManager -> String -> Integer -> IO ()
depositCollateral cm user amount = 
  modifyMVar_ (collateralMap cm) $ \m ->
    return $ Map.insertWith (+) user amount m

withdrawCollateral :: CollateralManager -> String -> Integer -> IO (Maybe Integer)
withdrawCollateral cm user amount = 
  modifyMVar (collateralMap cm) $ \m -> do
    let current = Map.findWithDefault 0 user m
    if current >= amount
      then return (Map.insert user (current - amount) m, Just amount)
      else return (m, Nothing)

-- Multi-pool interaction: allows composing operations across pools
executeMultiPoolLoan :: [LoanRequest] -> IO [TxResult]
executeMultiPoolLoan requests = do
  -- Execute loans concurrently - this is where the vulnerability manifests
  -- The poolLoanActive flag is checked per-loan but concurrent execution
  -- can interleave between the check and the state modification
  results <- mapM (\req -> async (executeFlashLoan req)) requests
  mapM wait results

-- Swap simulation for arbitrage within flash loan
simulateSwap :: Integer -> Integer -> Integer -> (Integer, Integer)
simulateSwap amountIn reserveIn reserveOut =
  let amountWithFee = amountIn * 997
      numerator = amountWithFee * reserveOut
      denominator = reserveIn * 1000 + amountWithFee
  in (numerator `div` denominator, reserveIn + amountIn)
